answer: Entry is priced by arrival order from one funding root: the first key deposits 100 POA bond in escrow for 8 epochs, the tenth 1000, the hundredth 10000, so cost climbs faster than headcount while honest keys pay only the first step. Roots are read from deposit history by peers doing audit work over a 12-epoch horizon; a cost spiral repeating from one purse is billed as one staircase, not many doors. Any key may challenge a suspected bridge of shared funding for 100 POA, and proven kinship will slash every bond on that ladder, so cloning buys tolls, never votes.
